description.html: The skull with gas mask is an unusual piece for fans of post-apocalyptic and industrial style. The mask straps run over the skull, two round lenses sit where the eyes are, and a protruding, ribbed filter replaces the mouth. Hoses and fittings are visible on the side, and the whole decoration has a beige, sandy texture, as if it had lain in the desert for a long time.

It fits best in desert terrariums with sand, stones and dry branches, where its color matches the substrate. It can be the centerpiece of a terrarium for a bearded dragon, leopard gecko or scorpion, or part of a themed setup with ruins and other skulls. This decoration is an ornament, not a hide, so give your animal a separate place to hide as well.

Place it on a flat surface or bury it slightly in the sand so the animal cannot tip it over. Do not put it directly under a heat source. Remove dust and sand from the ribbed filter and around the lenses with a soft brush; if needed, rinse it with lukewarm water and let it dry completely before putting it back.
